Read before locking please.
Hey, this is specifically addressed to Pel. If you aren't pel feel free to read but I would like Pel to respond and I'm sure lock it. Moving on...
Pel, read my appeals. Posidon told me I can appeal this infraction more. Racism was allowed if it was not directed at someone in 18+ both admins at the time agreed on this and informed me of this. Jozz even originally appealed this. When it was reinstated he told me  he wouldn't appeal me again because he was already in hot water. That rule was not applicable to that chat at the time of the offense. You guys seem to be incapable of understanding that your admins told me it was ok therefore I should not be held accountable. You also seem incapable on conversing with me over skype despite my numerous efforts to get you to discuss topics involving avicus, the tourney and my appeal. Therefore, you leave me no choice but to write more appeals. If your concern is that I or someone else is using skype resolvers. Which would make sense since went through the effort of restoring you compooter (which was useless btw) you have nothing to be concerned with, just having your skype username is enough for some kind of attack which I have no intention of doing. Effectively if you wanted to be rid of malicious content supplied by a competent hacker you would need: a new internet provider, compooter and skype. Please reconsider this TS ban and add me back on skype as the lack of communication between us causes nothing but more appeals to be created. If you would prefer we can meet on my TS to discuss things at a set date and time but I suggest you use a vpn as you seem to be trying to avoid allowing people to see your ip. Think about your response to this before answering please.

title: Appeal for TS

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello Zac,

I think the points you make are very fair, and if you were told that Racism is allowed, we can't hide behind that fact. I feel that you should be appealed, however there are a few things that I would like to make clear.

Racism is no longer allowed, and if you're caught being racist, you will be banned with no chance of appeal. Whether this is a perm or temp ban depends on the severity.

Secondly, you will be respectful towards staff and users alike. As rule A.1 states; Maintain a casual and positive atmosphere at all times. Inappropriate or aggressive language, regardless if it is directed at someone or not, will not be tolerated. Be respectful of all players. Harassment, bullying, rudeness and excessive swearing is strictly not allowed.

If you're caught doing so, you will be banned with no chance of appeal. Evidence does not need to be present.

And of course, anything that would be punishable is also included.

Is that clear?
